recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No follow-up core source work is needed for FHIR-6134 unless a future editorial pass chooses different wording for the DomainResource relationship paragraph for reasons unrelated to this issue.
issue_request: FHIR-6134 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 clarification asking to change the DomainResource relationship text from the ungrammatical "This resource is extends resource" wording to wording that says the resource extends the base Resource.
initial_application: No git commit explicitly mentions FHIR-6134. The exact typo was introduced in b30002f3e694 and implicitly corrected before Jira closure by c626e8ba4bf9, which changed source/domainresource/domainresource-introduction.xml from "This resource is extends ... resource" to "This resource extends the base ... resource". Jira comments also recorded "already done" before the issue was resolved and published.
additional_context: DomainResource remains in the current build scope through the active [resource-infrastructure] entry in source/fhir.ini. The current source preserves the corrected relationship statement and updates the list of direct Resource specializations to include Parameters alongside Bundle and Binary.
reconciliation: No source change was needed because the current in-build source already conveys the Jira-requested correction and no stale copy of the bad phrase was found in the relevant Resource/DomainResource source.
